Ewn.sourceCitation: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon, Book I, Part 5, p. 2202 (Perseus Digital Library)

senses: He sought, desired, asked, or demanded aid, help, or assistance of him; he had recourse to him for aid or assistance.
entries.rawSourceText: اسْتَعَانَهُ and اسْتَعَانَ بِهِ He sought, desired, or asked of him aid, help, or assistance.

senses: He aided, helped, or assisted him; he rendered him aid or assistance.
entries.rawSourceText: أَعَانَهُ He aided, helped, or assisted him.

senses: Aid, help, assistance; also used as an epithet for a helper or an assistant.
entries.rawSourceText: عَوْنٌ Aid, help, assistance; and a helper, an assistant.

Sbr.overview: To bind, restrain, withhold oneself from grief, agitation, or despair.
Sbr.sourceCitation: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon, Book I, Part 4, p. 1643 (Perseus Digital Library)

senses: He restrained, withheld, or confined himself (or another); he exercised patience, endurance, or self-command, refraining from complaint or agitation under trial or affliction.
entries.rawSourceText: صَبَرَ He restrained or withheld himself; he was patient, enduring, or steadfast.

senses: He exerted intensive patience; he held himself firmly with steadfast endurance and continuous perseverance.
entries.rawSourceText: اِصْطَبَرَ He exercised patience with effort, perseverance, and steadfast constancy.

senses: Patience, endurance; the restraint of the soul from impatience, grief, or perturbation under hardship.
entries.rawSourceText: صَبْرٌ Patience, endurance; self-restraint from complaint in calamity.

senses: Patient, enduring, steadfastly restraining oneself under adversity.
entries.rawSourceText: صَابِرٌ Patient, enduring, bearing affliction steadfastly.

xlT.overview: To mix, mingle, blend, or incorporate one thing with another.
xlT.sourceCitation: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon, Book I, Part 2, p. 784 (Perseus Digital Library)

senses: He mixed, mingled, blended, or incorporated one thing with another so that they became combined.
entries.rawSourceText: خَلَطَهُ He mixed, mingled, or blended it with another.

senses: It became mixed, mingled, blended together, or intertwined (as the diverse plants of the earth after rain).
entries.rawSourceText: اِخْتَلَطَ It became mixed, mingled, blended, or intermingled together.

senses: A partner, co-owner, or associate who shares property or affairs in common; something intermixed.
entries.rawSourceText: خَلِيطٌ A partner or associate in property; a mixture.

ryb.overview: Doubt, suspicion, or uncertainty accompanied by disquietude of mind.
ryb.sourceCitation: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon, Book I, Part 3, p. 1205 (Perseus Digital Library)

senses: Doubt, suspicion, or uncertainty; especially doubt that causes uneasiness, anxiety, or disquietude of the heart.
entries.rawSourceText: رَيْبٌ Doubt, suspicion, or disquietude of mind.

senses: It caused him doubt, suspicion, or disquietude; it rendered him uneasy or perturbed.
entries.rawSourceText: رَابَهُ It caused him doubt or disquietude.
